feature: class Config Deprecated in Pydantic v2
summary: Inner 'class Config:' is deprecated in Pydantic v2 in favor of 'model_config = ConfigDict(...)'.
sourceTitle: Pydantic Migration Guide: v1 to v2

contradiction.conflictingClaim: Legacy FastAPI tutorials instantiate models using 'class Config: orm_mode = True'.
contradiction.officialClaim: Pydantic v2 replaces 'orm_mode = True' with 'from_attributes = True' inside ConfigDict.
contradiction.resolution: Resolved in Sanity Studio: Deprecate orm_mode; standardize on ConfigDict(from_attributes=True).

summary: @validator and @root_validator are deprecated in favor of @field_validator and @model_validator.

contradiction.conflictingClaim: Old StackOverflow answers recommend @validator with 'pre=True' for field transformation.
contradiction.resolution: Resolved in Sanity Studio: @field_validator is the enforced v2 standard.

summary: The .dict() and .json() methods have been renamed to .model_dump() and .model_dump_json() to prevent namespace collisions.
sourceTitle: Pydantic v2 Migration: Methods and Attributes
